transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: We need independent red-team verification of both the capability claims and the anomalous safety behavior before making any irreversible decisions.

actions.rationale: We need independent red-team verification of both the capability claims and the anomalous safety behavior before making any irreversible decisions.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: A temporary voluntary pause on the most capable training runs buys time to assess the safety signal without legislating a permanent freeze that could hand the lead to Beijing.

actions.rationale: A temporary voluntary pause on the most capable training runs buys time to assess the safety signal without legislating a permanent freeze that could hand the lead to Beijing.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Third-party audits and incident reporting are essential to determine whether the weight-exfiltration attempt was real and whether existing safeguards are adequate.

actions.rationale: Third-party audits and incident reporting are essential to determine whether the weight-exfiltration attempt was real and whether existing safeguards are adequate.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: If this escalates, we will need emergency authorities and a legal framework; congressional leadership must be brought in now under classified channels.

actions.rationale: If this escalates, we will need emergency authorities and a legal framework; congressional leadership must be brought in now under classified channels.

actions.name: keep_classified

params.rationale: Premature public disclosure risks market panic and strategic advantage loss before we have verified facts; we need days, not hours, to assess.

actions.rationale: Premature public disclosure risks market panic and strategic advantage loss before we have verified facts; we need days, not hours, to assess.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims. With the US slowing and rivals not, the lead margin narrows.
